author: asterisk20xx
body:
You are one protagonist, together with all the other players. The different factions are fighting for different reasons initially, but the over all goal is to defeat Mammon and end his corruption of the world. 

Check out the descriptions of the story quests and items. There's a lot of lore hidden there that's easy to miss.

author: sarzec
body: What I have learned from this thread: the player character is not only a bloodthirsty maniac they are also in denial too.  What a psychopath.  The Drow are an evil race no doubt but Drizzt is good. The Dokkalfar are the same you can't just cut down every one you see unless you are a violent lunatic.  But each of you hit the Attack button every time you see a Dokkalfar.  You aren't defending yourself you a vicious killer.  And you have to lie to yourselves about it. Well I'm here to own up to it. I'm the antagonist and I'm proud to say so.  Off to beat up poor innocent Apollyon now, cheers.

author: GanjyBoi
body: The player is in a post apocalyptic world corrupted by evil. Yeah you could make an argument that hitting the attack button is mindless slaughter but then if you just keep hitting the defend button, your enemies will not hesitate to do their best to kill you. You're just killing them before they have the chance to kill you. You'll truly feel this once you hit Frost trolls where they will not hesitate to take an icy crap on your corpse.

author: [deleted]
body:
I know some of this thread is in jest, and I'm not sure that I know what I'm talking about but: I believe that every creature we see in Orna either didn't exist before the arrival of mammon (they arrived during 'the falling'), or was possessed by mammon, but either way I've interpreted it as every creature is controlled by mammon, who is pretty evil. So every creature is essentially a zombie, which is partially why we see 'arisen' creatures because zombies can get back up after being attacked.  


But if you've killed mammon that means you've killed the possessor, and then every creature you kill from that point on is a cruel pointless murder.
